visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair and straight bangs stands in front of a glass display case filled with numerous anime and superhero figurines. She is wearing a plain black t-shirt. She performs a series of rhythmic hand signs, pressing her palms and fingers together in complex patterns. She then rotates to show the back of her shirt, which features a red circular logo. (2) A bright white flash transitions the scene, and she is now wearing a black hooded jacket with a tall red collar and red cloud-like patterns. She continues to make hand gestures while looking directly at the camera with a focused, neutral expression. (3) After another visual flash, she returns to her black t-shirt attire, this time holding a prop kunai knife. She poses with the weapon, pointing it forward and then showing the back of her shirt again while glancing over her shoulder. (4) A final flash shows her in the hooded jacket again with the hood pulled up over her head. She adjusts the hood and the zipper, poses with her hands, and eventually looks at the camera with a slight smile and a peace sign.
